name: @briananders/pageweight
description: Simple node package that calculates the overall weight of a webpage on initial load without click interactions.

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => { fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('dist-extension', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('release', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/postbuild-npm.ts
scripts.build:extension: node -e "import('node:fs').then((fs) => fs.rmSync('dist-extension', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && tsc -p tsconfig.extension.json && node scripts/build-extension.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:extension
scripts.test: npm run build:all && npm run package:extension && node --test test/*.test.ts
